prediction_timing_samples: StaleGuard and EarlyRecovery: one approval forecast per seed; EarlyRecovery may act before dispatch; this is reported separately as early_recovery_lead, not a negative dispatch-to-action delay. Use-Time Recheck: one check per flight; FBS: approval-time feature/EMA update and TTL freeze per flight, not total observation-history or total policy computation. FBS cumulative observation computation sums recorded update timers through approval (including the approval update), only when diagnostics exist; it excludes dispatch and recording overhead. Missing history is unmeasured.
